hints: Use prefix sums so a segment from l through r has sum prefix[r]-prefix[l].
At each right endpoint r, allowed start prefixes range from r-b through r-a.
The largest segment sum uses the smallest prefix value in that active range; maintain it in a deque.
analogy: For each ending point, choose the lowest starting balance among starts whose segment length is allowed.
example: For values 2,-1,3,-2,5, a length 1..2 segment ending at the final 5 can use -2+5=3 or 5, while earlier segment 3-2+5=6 is best.
algorithm: Build prefix sums. As r advances, add prefix[r-a] to a monotonic increasing deque, remove indices below r-b, and maximize prefix[r]-prefix[deque.front].
correctness: Each permitted start is added when it becomes eligible and removed only after it leaves the length window; the deque front is the minimum eligible prefix, giving the best segment ending at r.
